OWASP · open source · MIT

API security testing that reads your code first.

OFFAT maps your API from source, follows every input across files on a code graph, runs its test plan with a Rust engine and triages the results with AI — or fully offline.

Get started → How it works
$offat-platform run ./repo -o app.offat.json
91routes mapped in Juice Shop, 4,260 functions in 6.3 s
16/16planted flows found, zero safe twins flagged
4protocols in one engine: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket, gRPC
0tokens required — every AI path has an offline fallback

What you get

One pipeline, one file, every stage inspectable.

01

Code graph, not grep

Interprocedural data flow for Python and JS/TS. Findings carry the hop-by-hop path and the route that reaches them.

 02

The Bundle contract

Every stage reads and writes one versioned JSON document. Stop, inspect, edit and resume anywhere.

 03

Identity-aware checks

Give it a few identities and it plans object- and function-level authorization checks with differential baselines.

 04

AI where it pays off

Cached, batched and model-tiered triage that sees the proven path, plus an agent that reads the code around it.

 05

A Rust engine

A single static binary for the network-heavy part: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, WebSocket, gRPC, HTTP/3 opt-in.

 06

CI-native output

SARIF with code flows for GitHub code scanning, JUnit, Markdown, HTML and a --fail-on gate.
